$description: Evidence ledger. Every citation in the design-repo (contracts, templates, asset roles, motion patterns, this file) is indexed in citationChecks with anchor text that must appear inside the cited lines; extraction/verify_all.py resolves them against the sibling source tree when present (WARN + skip when absent). Token evidence refs carry their own quotes in tokens/**.json. External evidence (source tree, specs, reference screenshots) is NEVER an entry point of the manifest.

sourceTree.identity: a parent folder containing src/ and package.json with name "lightdash-clone"

routeEvidence.note: measured = the route itself has a reference screenshot (reference/pages or reference/original-1440.png); measured-sample = the documented sample member of a CMS template (cms-templates.md line 12); template-derived = another member of a CMS family: layout inherited from the sample, metadata measured in specs/cms/*.json, body placeholder. The slugs behind the blog-category screenshots are not recorded in the source.

ia: ia/validate.mjs was run first and passes untouched (30 templates, 118 routes, 99 sections at build time; 100 after the 2026-10-13 IA update pass).

Routes: 118 routes / 30 templates verified against specs/sitemap.txt (121 URLs minus 3 unpublished), src/App.jsx route patterns and specs/cms/*.json member counts (62 posts, 11 categories, 12 stories, 4 events): the groundwork held.

Node lists: 9 of 30 templates differed from ia.json once re-read against the real JSX (product-conversational-analytics, product-data-apps, product-embedding, product-self-improving-analytics, playground, startups, fintech, blog-post, customer-story); see templates.json differsFromIa for each reason (repeated sections modelled as separate nodes, DOM order, an unmodelled Fintech band, the Playground card band).
Sections: 99 ia sections kept, 1 added (decor.pixel-border-band); app.* sections kept as non-composable iframe states.
ia.json meta.chromeAxis held: every template chrome value equals the value implied by its node list (verify_all.py routes check).
tokens: All 219 pre-existing evidence refs (ref + quote) resolved against the cited lines before any change; 0 bad.

60 Tailwind colours + #000000 matched tailwind.config.js exactly; 33 typography entries matched src/index.css (size, line-height, weight, letter-spacing, family, default colour); responsive overrides present.

FIXED / ADDED: 9 recurring raw hex values used by pages but absent from the Tailwind theme became color.local-* tokens (scope page-local); tokens/00-foundation/icon-size.json (9 icon boxes) and motion-patterns.json (20 patterns) were missing; tokens/llm/{token-catalog,token-policy,component-allowlist}.json were missing.
themes/dark-home.json differs from light.json in only 3 of 34 semantic keys (chrome nav bg / nav border / menu panel); the footer keys resolve identically but are unused on the homepage (no footer).

structurallyUnusual: The homepage is a full-viewport Three.js Game Boy app inside an iframe (public/gameboy/index.html): one viewport, no scroll, no footer. hero.* / app.* sections of the home template are iframe states; app.view-* are non-composable and live in templates.json iframeStates, never in nodes.
/__shared is a dev-only demo route (src/pages/SharedDemo.jsx): not a route of the design (templates.json devOnlyRoutes).

Three unpublished routes are excluded ON PURPOSE and must not be recreated: /old-home, /xdrafts/lightdash-vs-looker, /xdrafts/lightdash-vs-looker-v2 (templates.json excludedRoutes; verify_all.py fails if one appears).
Unknown URLs render the not-found template via the catch-all route "*" (HTTP 404 on live); it is not counted as a route.
Third-party scripts (Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack, Warmly, HubSpot) are not part of the design (thirdPartyScripts).

The source is a REAL live company: real customer logos, employees, quotes, compliance marks, roadmap, a Cal.com booking calendar, a YouTube video and forms. assets/asset-roles.json pins every role to a generation policy and forbids live endpoints in PageSpecs.

Article, story, event and legal bodies are placeholder text; their metadata is measured. Evidence is therefore per route: measured, measured-sample, template-derived (templates.json routes[].evidence).
/playground is an unfinished duplicate of the old homepage whose blocks render empty on the live site; /jp is Japanese copy; /about uses a 1000px desktop breakpoint and /jp 1440.

thirdPartyScripts.note: index.html loads only /src/main.jsx; the saved original HTML (not cited: a large third-party dump) does contain Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack and Warmly references.

anomalies.claim: Several logo image file names disagree with the brand they contain: public/assets/pages/fintech/hypebeast-*.png renders the Wise logo and kraken-*.png renders Titanbay (both viewed while building); fintech alma-*.png renders Peach Payments; src/pages/data/pricing.jsx maps the alt "octopus energy" to alma-*.svg (renders octopus energy) and "Adobe" to hyperbound-*.svg (renders Adobe). All five were viewed on 2026-10-13: every alt text matches its rendered logo and only the file names are wrong, so the source needs no fix. File names are Framer layer names: identify logos by alt text.
src/components/shared/README.md says load animations are left to the Animation agent, but src/motion/useRouteMotion.js implements hero fade, pixel drop and roadmap slides and InnerLayout mounts it.
SectionHero.jsx header comment says motion is "not implemented here, Animation agent"; it is implemented in src/motion/useRouteMotion.js via the data-hero / data-hero-pixel hooks.

PlaygroundHero.jsx documents a word-reveal motion with [data-pg-word] hooks, but nothing in src queries that attribute and ia.json records that the live page has no word-reveal: no motion pattern is claimed for it.
src/pages/_PageStub.jsx ("Temporary placeholder used by route stubs") is imported nowhere (grep -rl PageStub src lists only itself); it is not a route.
anomalies.keyword: Temporary placeholder used by route stubs

anomalies.claim: The /jp "demo" button points at the absolute live URL https://www.lightdash.com/start and the other at a real meetup.com event.
The /startups "Talk to our team" button opens a live Cal.com page (lightdash.cal.com/lightdash/startups), not the Talk modal.
The /fintech FAQ answers are mismatched with their questions; this is a reproduced live-site bug (source header comment).
The live /partnerships cell 4 href was "https://https://northstaranalytics.co.uk/"; the clone fixes it (source comment).
The /fintech full-bleed 1440x60 "Graphic Border" band is not a section in ia.json; modelled here as decor.pixel-border-band.
Blog / story / event bodies were not copied; PlaceholderBody renders lorem text. Metadata (titles, dates, authors, counts) is measured in specs/cms/*.json.
Legal page bodies (privacy, terms, sub-processors "Vendor A..M", Google APIs disclosure) are placeholder text written for the clone.
anomalies.keyword: Neutral placeholder copy for the legal pages

anomalies.claim: The footer newsletter form submits nowhere (UI only); the live HubSpot/Framer endpoint was not inspected.
PartnerForm and PadelApply call preventDefault and send no request; their live forms post to real backends that were not inspected.
One blog slug contains a typographic apostrophe: percent-encoded in the sitemap and ia.json, raw in specs/cms/blog.json; react-router decodes the param.
The /data-apps hero image is an iframe to the third-party deployment forecast-slider.vercel.app.
/__shared (src/pages/SharedDemo.jsx) is a dev QA route mounted in App.jsx but not a real site route.
Per CLONE_SPEC section 0 the Game Boy iframe still loads three.js, three-mesh-bvh and three-bvh-csg from jsDelivr: an external dependency of the original design.
The Britti Sans families in src/index.css are TRIAL-licence font files taken from the live site.
About team data keeps live typos ("lan Ahuja", "llonna Babakhanova", lowercase L for capital I).
